column2: Keeps the container in its slot filled from your water line. Needs a tap unlocked. No power.
Open: the container is kept full from the water line.
Only runs in the store grid or on a Shop Expansion shelf
Moves water from what touches its back end to what touches its arrow end. Set a water grade and it can take or refuse water by grade, and it can wait for a full source or an empty destination.
Off: the Faucet stops filling its container.
Writes one F8 console line per transfer and faucet fill.
When this pipe runs at night. 1-5 before machines, 6-10 after, 11-15 last. Hoppers use the same numbers.
Moves water from what touches its back end to what touches its arrow end.
Moves water around a corner, from what touches its back end to what touches its front end.
Switches the pipe on or off. An off pipe moves nothing.
On: the pipe runs once a night, at the order below, and not by day.
Pick one water grade. The input and output rules compare against it, and Any switches them off. A machine with a slot per grade takes the pipe set to that grade.
Which water the pipe takes from its source, compared with the grade above.
Whether the pipe pours into a container whose water is dirtier or cleaner than the grade above.
Input side: the pipe waits until its source is full, then moves the whole amount once the destination has room.
Output side: the pipe pours only into an empty destination, so a batch already there is never topped up. Protects a purifier's batch.

Gives the water of every linked Smart Bridge Pipe Inlet to what touches its front end. Drag an inlet onto it to link them.

Quality +100, enough for Pure water. Water purifier only, one per machine. The machine refuses water below High Quality, so purify to High Quality in another purifier first.

Needs the Upper Pipe Siphon. The grade your water line serves, never above what you have. The vanilla faucet follows it from the next morning.
A large industrial filter installed over your existing line. Every faucet serves ghostwater instead of rustwater.
Siphons the station's main line. The line serves Base water.

Siphons the pipes of the upper levels. The line serves High Quality water, and the line and each Faucet can serve a lower grade than the best you have: set the line in the mod settings and each faucet in its window.

A pipe piece that enriches water for hydroponics. Its intake end draws from a container, a machine or a pipe feeding it; its outlet end fills the hydroponic rack it touches with nutrient water. Runs on a battery, which pays per litre.
Draws at its intake end and fills a touching hydroponic rack at its outlet end with nutrient water
Does not clean water: contaminants pass through, so feed clean water to sensitive crops
Any, or a water grade: the biofilter then takes only water of that grade or better, and waits for the rest.
On: the biofilter runs only at night, before and after the machines. Off: it runs whenever water changes, like an always-on pipe.

Off: the Industrial Filter upgrade is not offered in the Wild and its water grade is not applied. Anything you bought is kept and returns when this is turned on.
Off: the Main Line Siphon Kit is not sold and its Base water is not applied. One you installed is kept and returns when this is turned on.
Off: the Upper Pipe Siphon Kit is not sold and its High Quality water and grade choice are not applied. One you installed is kept and returns when this is turned on.
What the upgrade costs in the Wild. A change applies at the next purchase.
The kit's value; the shop that sells it adds its usual markup. A change applies to kits stocked after it.
The kit's value. The Hypertech Smuggler adds his 50% markup, so the default 6700 sells near 10000. A change applies to kits stocked after it.
The price of every item this mod sells (faucet, pipes, tanks, Water Bottler, Algae Biofilter and Pure Module), in percent of the usual price. A change applies to items made after it.
How much the Compact Tank and the Cistern hold, in percent of the usual 10 L and 100 L. A change applies to tanks made after it; a tank you own keeps its size.
The battery charge the Algae Biofilter spends per litre of water it draws. Applies from its next move.

How many pipes, pipe pieces, tanks and faucets the shops stock, in percent of the usual amount: the Water Shop with Better Merchants, the retired water merchant's pipes without it. Machines and the Pure Module stay one at a time. Applies at once.
The chance that a Dr. Jackson arrival brings a Cistern, once the water line is bought. With Better Merchants running, its Water Shop sells the Cistern instead and this setting does nothing.
Fittings that siphon the station's main line. Drop it on your store's faucet to install it: the line serves Base water. Needs the Industrial Filter first.

Hypertech fittings that siphon the pipes of the upper levels. Drop it on your store's faucet to install it: the line serves High Quality water, and the line and each Faucet can serve a lower grade than the best you have. Needs the Main Line Siphon first.
Drop on the store's faucet to install. Used up when installed.
